neighbours.label: the 'TC' piece of the acronym NTC (thermistor, near-real-time) and similar letter fragments in acronyms
fire: The battery pack has an NTC thermistor to monitor cell temperature.
Products are delivered in NTC timeliness within three hours of sensing.
Replace the NTC sensor if the charger reports a fault.
Each module uses a 10k NTC resistor glued to the casing.
The firmware reads the NTC voltage every second.
Our data arrive in NTC mode for the fire monitoring service.
A cheap NTC probe was taped to the heatsink for testing.
The NTC value drops as the board warms up.

A cheap thermocouple was taped to the heatsink for testing.
